'''Pat Pulvino''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Rochester tournament]] on 16 December 2000 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1550">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-16-rochester-ny-12-16-2000d1550/ rochester-ny-12-16-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 16 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-16-rochester-ny-12-16-2000d1550/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
